```{r zoom in - crop function}
cropped.coords <- Crop(xenium.obj[["fov"]], x = c(8000, 12000), y = c(1000, 4000), coords = "plot")

# visualize cropped area with cell segmentations & selected molecules
```

```{r}
xenium.obj <- SCTransform(xenium.obj, assay = "Xenium")
xenium.obj <- RunPCA(xenium.obj, npcs = 30, features = rownames(xenium.obj))
xenium.obj <- RunUMAP(xenium.obj, dims = 1:30)
xenium.obj <- FindNeighbors(xenium.obj, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
xenium.obj <- FindClusters(xenium.obj, resolution = 0.3)

# make a umap
DimPlot(xenium.obj, cols = "polychrome")
ggsave(here("Xenium", "plots", "our_first_xenium_umap.png"))

ImageDimPlot(xenium.obj, cols = "polychrome", size = 0.75)
ggsave(here("Xenium", "plots", "our_first_xenium_image_umap.png"))
```

## Mapping coordinates

```{r}
# read in file exported from 10X explorer containing the names of the cells on interest
block_c_cellIDs_files <-list.files("/mmfs1/gscratch/iscrm/OperationBloodMoon/Xenium/xenium_cell_stats/block_c", full.names = TRUE)

block_c_cellIDs_dfs<-lapply(block_c_cellIDs_files, read_csv, skip =2)

names(block_c_cellIDs_dfs) <-block_c_cellIDs_files

block_c_cellIDs<-bind_rows(block_c_cellIDs_dfs, .id = "file") %>%
    mutate(file = str_replace(file, "/mmfs1/gscratch/iscrm/OperationBloodMoon/Xenium/xenium_cell_stats/block_c/", "")) %>%
    separate(file, sep = "_", into = c("block", "phase", "tissue"), extra = "drop") %>%
    select(1:4) %>%
    as.data.frame(.)

#The cell ids need to be rownames so we can use addmetadata
rownames(block_c_cellIDs)<-block_c_cellIDs$`Cell ID`
```

```{r}
#make the cell ID info we just made into metadata for the block c seurat object.
```

```{r}
AddCellIDs<-function(block){
    
files<-list.files(paste0("/mmfs1/gscratch/iscrm/OperationBloodMoon/Xenium/xenium_cell_stats/block_",block), full.names = TRUE)

dfs<-lapply(files, read_csv, skip =2)

names(dfs) <-files

cellIDs<-bind_rows(dfs, .id = "file") %>%
    mutate(file = str_replace(file, "/mmfs1/gscratch/iscrm/OperationBloodMoon/Xenium/xenium_cell_stats/block_./", "")) %>%
    separate(file, sep = "_", into = c("block", "phase", "tissue"), extra = "drop") %>%
    select(1:4) %>%
    as.data.frame(.)


#The cell ids need to be rownames so we can use addmetadata
rownames(cellIDs)<-cellIDs$`Cell ID`

#return the dataframe
cellIDs
                  
}

```


```{r}
# remember that sample A L vag is missing, it was just some tiny shreds on the slide :(
block_a_cellIDs<-AddCellIDs(block = "a")
block_b_cellIDs<-AddCellIDs(block = "b")
block_c_cellIDs<-AddCellIDs(block = "c")
block_d_cellIDs<-AddCellIDs(block = "d")
block_e_cellIDs<-AddCellIDs(block = "e")
block_f_cellIDs<-AddCellIDs(block = "f")

# Use our AddMetaData function to add the cellIDs, phase and tissue to the seurat objects for each block
block_a<-AddMetaData(block_a, block_a_cellIDs)
block_b<-AddMetaData(block_b, block_b_cellIDs)
block_c<-AddMetaData(block_c, block_c_cellIDs)
block_d<-AddMetaData(block_d, block_d_cellIDs)
block_e<-AddMetaData(block_e, block_e_cellIDs)
block_f<-AddMetaData(block_f, block_f_cellIDs)


#Save these as rds to load next time
# use a function
save_rds <- function(block, name) {
    write_rds(block, paste0("/mmfs1/gscratch/iscrm/OperationBloodMoon/Xenium/data/rds/", name, "_with_cellIDs.rds"))
}

save_rds(block_a, "BlockA")
save_rds(block_b, "BlockB")
save_rds(block_c, "BlockC")
save_rds(block_d, "BlockD")
save_rds(block_e, "BlockE")
save_rds(block_f, "BlockF")
```

```{r}

# get the seurat obj .rds that we made before with the cellids


#get a list of those rds files
blocks_with_cellIDs<-list.files("/mmfs1/gscratch/iscrm/OperationBloodMoon/Xenium/data/rds", pattern = "with_cellIDs", recursive =  TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

#read them in as a list
blocks_with_cellIDs<-lapply(blocks_with_cellIDs, read_rds)


# Function to subset our blocks with cellIDs by tissue

SubsetByTissue<-function(seurat_with_cellIDs){
   SplitObject(seurat_with_cellIDs, split.by = "tissue")
}

#now we have a list of lists omg! There is a list of seurat objects where the elemnts are the blocks and in each of those is a list of sub-objects divided by tissue. So block A has a list of obj called vag, rect and skin each of which are seurat objects themselves.
block_tissue_list<-lapply(blocks_with_cellIDs, SubsetByTissue)

#using map like this means "go into my list called block_tissue_list" and get the element out called skin
skin<-map(block_tissue_list, "skin")

vag<-map(block_tissue_list, "vag")

rect<-map(block_tissue_list, "rect")

#now we have 3 lists: skin, vag and rect and each of those has a list of 6 seurat objects originating from the 6 blocks.

#To get a single seurat object PER TISSUE TYPE we need to merge the 6 elements

# take my skin list, use this 1, -1 thing to merge all the list elements and say that we want to append our cell ids with "blockX" where X is the block identifier

skin<-merge(
    skin[[1]],
    skin[-1],
    add.cell.ids = paste0("block", LETTERS[1:6])
)

write_rds(skin, paste0("/mmfs1/gscratch/iscrm/OperationBloodMoon/Xenium/data/rds", "all_skin_object.rds"))


vag<-merge(
    vag[[1]],
    vag[-1],
    add.cell.ids = paste0("block", LETTERS[1:6])
)

write_rds(vag, paste0("/mmfs1/gscratch/iscrm/OperationBloodMoon/Xenium/data/rds", "all_vag_object.rds"))



rect<-merge(
    rect[[1]],
    rect[-1],
    add.cell.ids = paste0("block", LETTERS[1:6])
)

write_rds(rect, paste0("/mmfs1/gscratch/iscrm/OperationBloodMoon/Xenium/data/rds", "all_rect_object.rds"))


```
